paragraphs.text:
You notice that the sasquatches regard Sylvia differently from 
you and Norman. They let her out of the overhang and allow 
her to wander around the camp. You encourage her to go. The 
sasquatch cubs approach her, shy or playful.

When Sylvia returns to you and Norman, you wonder if this 
state of affairs can be turned to your advantage.
Make an INT roll: if you succeed, go to 387; if you fail, go to 389.
